description: Free and local: lists the sealed-review receipts this server saved on this machine (newest first), or returns one in full by its review_id, plus today's paid spend. Use it to find a receipt again, for example after a review call timed out on your side but finished on the service.

id.description: A review_id to fetch in full. Leave it out to list recent receipts.

limit.description: How many recent receipts to list (default 20).

name: saved_receipts
title: List saved review receipts
